notice: Тестовый прототип. Границы, глубина и прикрепления не подтверждены. Не учебно допущенная модель.
algorithm: Measured hand frame + RBF envelope of existing hypothenar/retinaculum surfaces + closed parametric lamina

parameter_evidence.thickness_mm: 0.89 mm is a cadaveric sample mean from Nam et al. 2022, PMID35037581 (30 hands, SD0.16). Applied only as a test extrusion, not a validated thickness of this subject.
parameter_evidence.radial_mm/distal_mm/edge_taper/clearance: Explicit design assumptions. No anatomical measurement or pin. These values forbid automatic educational admission.
parameter_evidence.frame: Derived from world-space pisiform and metacarpal II/V vertex centroids. Not attachment coordinates.
parameter_evidence.surface: Envelope interpolation of adjacent meshes is a technical support surface, not skin, fascia, or palmaris brevis segmentation.
parameter_evidence.fibers: Schematic transverse direction only; no individual fascicles or histological reconstruction.

blocking_requirements: Skin deep boundary and ulnar insertion curve in the same hand frame
Ulnar palmar-aponeurosis boundary and retinacular origin footprint
Proximal/distal muscle outline and resting thickness map from registered ultrasound/MRI/dissection
Anatomist review of relations to ulnar canal, skin and hypothenar muscles

provenance.author: Миология 3D — procedural research prototype, 2026
provenance.scope: Conservative ShareAlike for prototype derived from context envelopes and context copies. No paper/reference images or meshes copied.
